body.description: With getPolicy: the current version's text, as Markdown.

current.description: The version in force; none before the first is published.

draft.description: The draft its next version is published from.

kind.description: policy: one of CMP-07's eight policies, which every member acknowledges. notice: a privacy notice (CMP-PD-03): the members' notice, which every member acknowledges, or the contacts' notice, whose summary goes in what Fyniq sends to contacts.

members.description: How many members the current version applies to.

mine.description: The caller's acknowledgement of the current version; none before one is published, and none for the contacts' notice, which members do not acknowledge.

sources.description: With getPolicy: the official sources Fyniq's starting draft was written from.

summary.description: A notice's summary: the first paragraph of its version in force. The contacts' summary ends every email Fyniq sends to a contact.
examples: We keep the names, email addresses and phone numbers of the people we deal with at our customers and suppliers...

versions.description: With getPolicy: every published version, oldest first.
